name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine a short distance back.
Hold the rope ends beside your temples and hinge slightly at the hips to create tension.
Exhale and curl your ribs down toward your pelvis, rounding your upper and middle back.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, then uncurl slowly back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your hips steady over your knees so the motion comes from spinal flexion, not hip hinging.
Keep your hands fixed beside your head rather than pulling down with your arms.
